_key.description: Gene symbol, Ensembl transcript ID, protein HGVS and coding HGVS joined by underscores. "?" is rewritten to "!" and ">" to "-". A "_splicing" suffix is added when aapos is -1.

ref.description: Reference amino acid. A stop is stored as "*"; dbNSFP writes that as X.

alt.description: Alternate amino acid. A stop is stored as "*"; dbNSFP writes that as X.

aapos.description: 1-based amino acid position in the protein. -1 when the variant is a splice-site SNP (2 bp at either end of an intron).

gene_name.description: HGNC gene symbol assigned by dbNSFP.

protein_name.description: UniProt entry name matching the Ensembl protein.

protein_id.description: Ensembl protein ID matching the transcript.

codonpos.description: Position of the variant within the codon: 1, 2 or 3. Null when not applicable.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID this coding consequence is annotated on.

SIFT_score.description: SIFT score from 0 to 1. Smaller values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score for this protein.

SIFT4G_score.description: SIFT 4G score from 0 to 1. Smaller values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score for this transcript.

Polyphen2_HDIV_score.description: PolyPhen-2 HumDiv probability from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

Polyphen2_HVAR_score.description: PolyPhen-2 HumVar probability from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

VEST4_score.description: VEST 4.0 score from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely to cause a functional change. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

REVEL_score.description: REVEL ensemble pathogenicity score from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

MutPred_score.description: MutPred score from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

BayesDel_addAF_score.description: BayesDel meta-score with maximum allele frequency included. Higher values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

BayesDel_noAF_score.description: BayesDel meta-score without maximum allele frequency. Higher values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

VARITY_R_score.description: VARITY_R pathogenicity score for rare missense variants, from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

VARITY_ER_score.description: VARITY_ER pathogenicity score for extremely rare missense variants, from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

VARITY_R_LOO_score.description: VARITY_R score with leave-one-variant-out scoring of training variants, from 0 to 1. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

VARITY_ER_LOO_score.description: VARITY_ER score with leave-one-variant-out scoring of training variants, from 0 to 1. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

ESM1b_score.description: ESM1b log-likelihood ratio. Smaller (more negative) values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

AlphaMissense_score.description: AlphaMissense pathogenicity score from 0 to 1. Larger values are more likely pathogenic. Null when dbNSFP has no score.

CADD_raw_score.description: CADD raw score. Larger values are more likely damaging. Null when dbNSFP has no score.
